source: Residual connections also impose shape discipline. IfZXMATH0000XZ thenZXMATH0001XZ must be inZXMATH0002XZ at the point of addition. That is why an attention branch with many heads ends in an output projection and why an MLP that expands to widthZXMATH0003XZ ends with a down projection.
